info.title: ChargeDesk Universal API
info.description: ChargeDesk helps support teams manage billing data, charges, customers, subscriptions, products, webhooks, and billing activity across connected payment gateways.

post.description: Creates a new charge in ChargeDesk.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

amount.description: Decimal amount for the charge, without a currency symbol.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the charge.

customerId.description: Unique customer identifier for the charge.

get.description: Retrieves a charge preview from ChargeDesk.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: chargeId
parameters.description: Charge to preview.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Product to preview. Ignored if Charge ID is also provided.

schema.description: Product to preview. Ignored if Charge ID is also provided.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Amount to preview. Required if no charge or product is provided; otherwise overrides the charge or product amount.

schema.description: Amount to preview. Required if no charge or product is provided; otherwise overrides the charge or product amount.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency to preview. Required if no charge or product is provided; otherwise overrides the charge or product currency.

parameters.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the customer location.

parameters.name: taxNumber
parameters.description: Customer tax identification number used to determine whether 0% tax should apply.

parameters.name: addTax
parameters.description: Override the company setting for whether tax is added to or included in the final amount.
